lines.text: The king of Egypt dethroned Jehoahaz, made his brother Eliakim king as Jehoiakim, and carried Jehoahaz off to Egypt.
Jehoiakim reigned eleven years and did evil, and Nebuchadnezzar bound him with bronze shackles and took articles to his temple in Babylon.
Jehoiachin reigned three months and ten days, then Neco summoned him to Babylon and made Zedekiah king.
God gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar, whose Chaldeans burned the house of God and carried survivors to Assyria.
The LORD stirred Cyrus king of Persia to proclaim that the LORD appointed him to build a house at Jerusalem.
